document.abstract: A side optical system was added to a 16mm Fastax camera to enable correlation of data with the event photographs or to allow the camera to be used for streak recording. The side optical system was installed without permanent camera alterations through a separate camera door. The image is reflected up to the film plane five frames ahead of the event frame.
